Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Trial + evaluation materials — next steps

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Pilot Retail would like to proceed with a short evaluation: we want to run a two-week sandbox against a curated set of customer-support queries and a small prompt pack (approx. 400 prompts) to validate accuracy and latency on your hosted endpoint.

Primary asks before we share data:
- A clear MAP with milestones + ownership so procurement can sign off.
- Proof that the dataset will be ephemeral (sandbox only), retention window, and destruction steps.
- Constraints on usage (no retraining, no replication outside the sandbox).

We can share a redacted sample CSV (no PII) and the full prompt pack once we have the MAP and basic legal/ops guardrails. Can you send a proposed timeline and the acceptance criteria you typically use for these trials? We’re targeting contract close by May 5 if the trial meets our QA gates.

Best,
Arielle Martin
Head of Product, Pilot Retail

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Arielle Martin <arielle@pilotretail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tom Benson <tbenson@apex-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Ephemeral evaluation data & prompt pack — MAP and close dates

Arielle — thank you, this is great and aligned with what we normally run. High-level proposal (attached: map_timeline_PilotRetail_v1.pdf):

1) MAP & signoff (2 business days): we’ll provide a one-page MAP that lists milestones, owners, and deliverables. Owner: Karthik (sales) + Monica (onboarding).
2) Sandbox provisioning (day 1): sandbox hosted instance + ephemeral storage; KEK-managed encryption. Token-limited access for Pilot Retail testers.
3) Data ingest + QA run (days 2–4): Pilot supplies redacted CSV sample, Redwood runs ingest; acceptance tests executed.
4) Prompt pack validation (days 5–10): we run the 400 prompts; acceptance criteria: intent match >= 85% on core intents, median p99 latency <= 350ms in our hosted config.
5) Review & decision (days 11–14): joint review meeting; if pass, proceed to contract close.

Usage constraints we require (will be in the MAP):
- Data is ephemeral: retained only for the sandbox window; auto-takedown 30 days after trial end, with certification of deletion.
- No model fine-tuning or export of raw dataset outside the sandbox.
- Access limited to named Pilot Retail users (we’ll publish a roster).

I’ve attached a draft prompt pack (pilot_eval_promptpack_v1.zip) and the MAP timeline PDF. Marissa is copying in operational constraints and can confirm the provisioning lead times.

If the timeline works, I’ll send the MAP as a DocuSign and a one-page ops checklist for security/compliance to speed procurement. Targeting your May 5 close is achievable if we start this week.

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: pilot_eval_promptpack_v1.zip (400 prompts, README), map_timeline_PilotRetail_v1.pdf

Karthik — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A couple of clarifications before we sign:

1) Deletion cert: can Redwood provide a deletion certification (signed) once data is destroyed? Our legal needs this for audit.
2) Sandbox telemetry: we need access to token/latency logs for the evaluation window (read-only). Is there a way to surface aggregated dashboards or a CSV export we can pull?
3) Test account provisioning: Tom will be the admin for our side; he needs a service account for automation. How are service accounts scoped?

Also, we’d like to add a clause: for any outputs that could be customer-identifying, Redwood will flag them and coordinate secure redaction before sharing. Is that acceptable operationally?

Assuming yes, please send the DocuSign MAP + the ops checklist and we’ll route it through procurement today. If we sign on Monday, we can start the sandbox Tuesday and keep to the May 5 target.

— Arielle
